maya_pm: Heads up 0min: Orion (reseller) needs a short POC spec covering entitlements, egress cost model, and KMS options. Want a one-page runbook by Thu.
zhou_partner: They specifically asked how we meter egress per downstream customer and whether we can apply different retention/ingest policies per tenant.
erin_sales: Pricing question: give two clear scenarios for a 4-customer pilot: (1) per-tenant reserved vGPU slices, (2) pooled Dedicated with per-tenant metering. They also want an example of egress $/GB numbers and how that flows to the reseller billing.
claire_infra: Metering: we can emit per-tenant usage events (tokens, output bytes, inference time). Those feed into billing pipeline. Egress bytes are measured per-tenant NAT gateway if dedicated VPC; otherwise per-tenant tag on shared egress.
rajesh_sec: KMS: for regulated tenants recommend per-tenant CMKs; reseller can either bring their own key (BYOK) or we host tenant CMKs in their HSM-backed keyring. Need to confirm Orions preference.
zhou_partner: Orion wants BYOK for enterprise customers but open to our per-tenant CMKs for quick pilots. They need the contract language to say logs and telemetry will be redacted before sharing.
maya_pm: Can we produce a short consent template + telemetry appendix for their SOW? Also need a decision on retention windows per tenant.
erinsales: I'll draft the pricing lines. Example roughs: reserved slice 3 vGPU equiv ~ $6.8k/mo per tenant; pooled 6 vGPU pool for 4 customers ~ $24k/mo (~$6k/customer) + egress at $0.08/GB. Need 95th/99th token assumptions.
claire_infra: ETA to provision pooled cluster for demo: 4 business days. Dedicated per-tenant slices: 9 business days. I'll spin demo tenants once we agree. bot-provisioner: ticket 56321 created by claire_infra: "Orion POC - pooled cluster + demo tenants" ETA 4d.
rajesh_sec: For PHI/HIPAA scoped tenants: HSM-backed CMKs + tenant-scoped audit streams required. Also recommend disabling high-fidelity logs to reseller and provide redacted troubleshooting logs instead.
zhou_partner: They asked whether we can expose a read-only log view scoped to the reseller for their ops team. Is that allowed?
rajesh_sec: Yes, with role-based access and PII masking enabled. We'll document the masking configuration in the runbook.
maya_pm: Blockers: (1) confirm BYOK vs per-tenant CMK default (rajesh), (2) produce pricing / egress examples (erin), (3) produce runbook + provisioning demo script (claire). Owners assigned.
erinsales: I'll upload a short spreadsheet with token assumptions and egress scenarios by EOD.
claire_infra: Demo plan: show CLI provisioning + console toggle for tenant-level retention and log redaction. Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tenants -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"name":"orion-cust-1","tier":"pilot"}'```
zhou_partner: I'll collect Orion's sample IdP metadata and BYOK instructions.
rajesh_sec: I'll prepare two short options for the SOW: Option A (pilot default): per-tenant CMKs managed by Redwood; Option B: BYOK with reseller-managed keying + attestation. Deliver Tue.
maya_pm: Let's meet Wed 10am PT to finalize the one-pager and runbook. Adding draft owners to the calendar. :calendar:
